scope: Local component ownership, allocator release, maximum observed memory and synchronous session elapsed intervals; no hosted run or public raw-run URL.

sources.fix: PendingOutbound::new clears update.shared_group_encode after election; active cursors and unstarted followers keep their owners.
sources.original_build_note: The four recorded precommit source trees are local Git tree identities, not published commits. Equal instrumentation was applied to the parent. Compiled production/probe source applicability was checked against the named commits.
sources.final_memory_applicability: The final commit isolates the allocator-control dependency behind retention-probe. Probe algorithm and production release behavior are unchanged. Original matched-instrumentation memory results apply; no duplicate memory campaign ran.
sources.normal_dependency_graph: 142 normalized library nodes match; neither normal elapsed binary includes tikv-jemalloc-ctl. Both independently rebuilt binaries match their original hashes.

instrumented_parent_memory.source_note: Parent source with the same test instrumentation and allocator-control dependency as the candidate; release assignment absent.

instrumented_candidate_memory.source_note: Release assignment present. Later differences to applicability commit affect tests or prose, not compiled benchmark behavior.

instrumented_parent_elapsed.source_note: Parent source with the same test instrumentation and allocator-control dependency as the candidate; release assignment absent.

instrumented_candidate_elapsed.source_note: Release assignment present. Later differences to applicability commit affect tests or prose, not compiled benchmark behavior.

procedure.quiet: Exclusive host lock; two accepted samples at least 30 seconds apart, load1 < 2, all CPU governors performance, no competing build/test/daemon process, no swap counter change.
procedure.timing_domain: Sum of synchronous session Instant intervals; writer drains excluded; not CPU time.
procedure.memory_processes: One fresh process per shape per leg; 24 in the original full campaign.
procedure.allocation_domain: jemalloc stats snapshots and per-thread allocated/deallocated counters around the final announcement advance.

frozen_bars.ownership: Every candidate stream must lose its final owner before blocked End-of-RIB, while the final queued writer frame may remain owned.
frozen_bars.memory_maximum: Maximum observed value across the six recorded phases.
frozen_bars.memory_abba: mean(candidate abba2, abba3 maxima) <= max(mean(parent abba1, abba4 maxima) * 1.05, mean(parent maxima) + 33554432)
frozen_bars.memory_confirmation: candidate confirm2 maximum <= max(parent confirm1 maximum * 1.05, parent confirm1 maximum + 33554432)
frozen_bars.elapsed_failure: ABBA and confirmation must both exceed the limit to fail.
frozen_bars.independent_selection: Prospectively selected cells with symmetric A/A > 1.02. Replicas report both their fresh and original limits; unresolved disagreement required investigation.
frozen_bars.drop_duration: Report-only; 50000000 ns reference. No duration gate was added.

original_matched_instrumentation.reason: All frozen ownership, allocation, maximum-observed memory and 13-cell elapsed bars pass.

dependency_mismatched_replica.reason: ABBA and confirmation exceed the fresh 1.02 limit. The original limit passes. Parent and candidate dependency graphs differ; preserve FAIL without attributing a runtime cause.

corrected_normal_dependencies.reason: All 13 cells pass the unchanged elapsed bar on matching normal dependency graphs.

final_independent_replica.reason: ABBA and confirmation are below both the fresh and original limits.

retained_invalid_attempts.reason: Script lacked executable permission; no host lock, quiet gate or measurement ran. The unchanged script then ran through bash.

retained_invalid_attempts.shape: Four nonquiet memory correctness smokes and two elapsed correctness smokes
retained_invalid_attempts.reason: No canonical quiet gates; excluded from qualification.

controls.ownership_regression: Parent fails, fixed candidate passes, removing only the release assignment fails; 8193 routes per unicast/VPN fixture.
controls.invalid_input_controls: Missing cells/phases, failed commands, nonfinite values, too-short quiet spacing and identical binaries rejected.

vmhwm_limitation.meaning: Maximum observed VmHWM remains the original measured domain and bar. No true lifetime peak-RSS claim follows. Ownership and allocator conclusions do not depend on VmHWM.

separate_same_environment_control.method: One barrier-frozen process with 12 pinned workers; 112 ordinary 4096-byte pages faulted then discarded per worker. Stable process identity.

vmhwm_limitation.limit: Demonstrates non-monotonic reporting in this environment; does not establish the exact kernel path for the retention campaign or repair the lifetime peak.

reproduction.parent_overlay: Apply the identical probe/test instrumentation to the parent; leave the production release assignment absent. Use separate builds and the same quiet procedure.

limits: No daemon/fleet scale, TCP delivery, routing convergence, remote application or forwarding qualification.
Allocator release does not establish RSS reduction.
No hosted run, hosted artifact or public raw-log URL is claimed. Curated medians and memory rows are the published numerical record; raw campaign logs remain unchanged.
